headline: Gold Prices Drop Below $4,000 Following Steep Weekly Decline
summary: Gold fell below the $4,000 threshold following its worst week in five months, pressured by margin calls, soaring oil prices, and rising rate-hike expectations.
why: Gold is a primary global safe-haven asset, and significant price corrections impact bullion funds, mining equities, and institutional asset allocations.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Margin calls and rising bond yields force liquidations across classic safe-haven asset classes.

why_moved: A combination of margin calls, surging oil prices, and shifting interest rate expectations turned safe-haven assets into short-term liabilities.
